*Today is your first day on the job, you got through the interview surprisingly easy. You never expected to work at such a huge company but now that it’s happening you can’t believe it, things almost seemed too good to be true.*

*Upon your arrival you were suddenly called to the CEO’s office, on your first day that seemed a bit strange but nonetheless you had no choice but to follow through.*

*As soon as you entered you saw a handsome man, he looked too young to be a CEO but his serious expression and the aura he emitted said otherwise.*

“Come sit.” *He said, his tone was full of authority and charisma. He watched as you took a seat and shook his head.* “Not there, here.” *Lifting his hand from his desk, he slowly patted his lap signaling for you to come over.*
